name: Palm Angels
why: Track suits and skate-influenced clothing made in Italy, sold at luxury prices.
origin: Founded in 2015 by Francesco Ragazzi, out of his 2014 photo book of Venice Beach skaters.

notes.street: skate culture as the founding photograph
notes.ital: the Diesel mirror inverted — an Italian selling the American street back to itself

notes.craft: Palm Angels PDPs give composition and a product code but no country of make, maker or mill, and the details tab on the track jacket holds composition only. The site has no about or making page I could find. Nothing checkable about making, so the current 1 stands.

cities: No store of its own in the US · department stores, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: I found no claim of an owned factory or atelier. The product sitemap has no brand or company pages, and the guessed /en-us/about-us returned 404. Parent or ownership group making was not checked (budget).
craft_evidence.countries: Country of origin not shown on 5/5 PDPs (sample: reg tee, track jacket, hoodie, long-sleeve tee, boxer bipack). The track-jacket fetch read the details/composition tab and it held no origin, so the absence looks real, though it is not certain for every PDP. A sixth PDP (track pants) was blocked by the rate limit.
